hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); git add -A 2>/dev/null; if git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then printf "{\"systemMessage\": \"Auto-commit: nenhuma alteracao pendente na branch '$branch'.\"}"; else git commit -m "chore: auto-commit ao final da interacao" 2>/dev/null && git push -u origin "$branch" 2>/dev/null && printf "{\"systemMessage\": \"Auto-commit e push realizados na branch '$branch'.\"}"; fi
